nom: DERMA E Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Scrub with Glycolic Acid

avis.texte: This is my favorite face wash in my routine. I use it 2-3x a week in rotation with other DermaE product. I love the texture with the exfoliating beads. It leaves my skin feeling so incredibly smooth after (and during) applying. My esthetician has commented on the improvement in my skin and I can definitely say this is in part to DermaE and this product.

I've been using this for several years. I feel like it does a good job exfoliating my skin. It's not overly abrasive. After rinsing, my face feels clean and smooth. Some viewers complain about the smell. It's not highly fragranced, which to me is a good thing.
The texture is awful; when you rinse it off, all the granules stick to your eyelashes, and of course, it smells terrible!

avis.titre: My complexion has never been better
avis.texte: I use this nightly amd sometimes in am. My skin is on the oily side so it doesn't make my skin dry. I have sensitive skin and most cleansers will cause acne. I love all these natural Derme products
This leaves my skin so clean, smooth, and soft. I use it every night and let it dry as a mask before rinsing.

Ultimately my issue with this product is the texture. The "grit" in it is too chunky but there is also not enough of it in the cream base to feel like a scrub. I felt like it barely did anything. It also congealed very easily and kept clogging the tube. I got tired of constantly having to clean the opening to get product out and ended up throwing out an almost full bottle. Waste of money. I cannot speak to how well the product worked for improving my skin since I hardly used any of it.
Other reviews are spot on- this smells like a cleaning product. Returned it immediately.

The smell on this product and the other products of this brand smells absolutely horrible!!! My stomach is turning from the smell. Definitely will be returning this and going in person to make sure i never get this experience.

I've been using this scrub for a couple weeks now and I love the gritty texture of it and the way it feels on my skin. It provides great exfoliation for my skin and I feel like my skin is smoother and more youthful looking, since using it.

avis.titre: Please never stop selling this really cleans helps with wrik
avis.texte: It's really clean your face feels so soft and it definitely shows improvement and wrinkles

avis.titre: Pretending not to be Apricot Scrub
avis.texte: I was super excited for this product. But as soon as I squeezed some onto my fingers it brought me flashbacks to high school and that apricot scrub we all swore was great but was really just killing our skin. To my surprise apricot seed powder is one of the main ingredients... I feel betrayed by this skincare brand I have come to love and trust.

I'm 24, but I use this product to exfoliate my acne-prone, sensitive skin. Not only is it gentle, it really does help soften and reduce blemishes and fine lines. My BF uses it to help with his flaky, dry skin (post acne treatment). This stuff rocks.

We had used this for quite sometime, but this past year we have been trying to stray away from physical exfoliators. That said, it doesn't feel terribly rough and skin feels great and clean after. After we finished this, we tried it's non-scrub counterpart and was happy we made the switch.
This product does not remove areas of dead skin cells near lips, chin, or nose well. I felt it was not effective in polishing off skin after a mask or treatment.

avis.titre: Smells like Bathroom Cleaner and Doesn't Scrub.
avis.texte: I used this product once in the shower. Not trying to spend too much, I bought this face wash- I used Derma E scar gel and it works wonders, so thought this would too. This ended up smelling like legitimate bathroom cleaner. I used it once- the scrub is so sparse that it's like random beads where scattered across my face. Didn't give me the opportunity to scrub at all.

Well this was my first time using this product and I LOVE IT !!!! I have fine lines on my forehead and I hate them & using this product has helped so much . I wet my face first then add the product to my face & neck. I do leave it on for a few then wash off with warm water. This product leaves my face so soft and smooth . I then use a face cream so my skin looks flawless .
I loved this product when I received it in my ipsy bag. I've been hooked on this brand ever since. I'm so glad ulta started carrying the product that made me fall in love
